abstract: Let N_λ(X) count coprime triples a+b=c≤X with rad(abc)<c^λ. We generalize a two-letter collision inequality and obtain N_λ(X)≪X^{54/91+ε} for 0<λ≤1, with the sharper certified exponent 5588/9417. The inequality allows arbitrary coprime exponent pairs on one letter and arbitrary nonempty sets of free coordinates on a second. Its proof uses a Bézout parametrization in the unit group and uniform bounds for differences of powerful monomials. We also determine exact program values at five radical budgets and derive a piecewise-linear envelope β(λ) on [0.70,1.10] by reusing rational Farkas multipliers. This envelope improves throughout that interval on the minimum of the trivial bound and the applicable bounds of Bernert, Browning, Lichtman and Teräväinen. Zhang (Zenodo, 29 August 2026) proved the uniform exponent 34/59 for 0<λ≤1 by valuation-tail methods; the envelope β(λ) is smaller than his pointwise exponent for 0.70≤λ<0.9419… and gives new exponents for 1<λ≤1.10, while 34/59 is the smaller exponent for 0.9419…≤λ≤1. In particular, the exponent 3/5 remains valid up to λ=247/245. The arithmetic constraints and rational certificates establish the upper bounds; feasible points describe their limitations. The supplement provides the certificates, independent exact verifiers, numerical comparisons and a reproducible figure. The manuscript was produced with substantial AI assistance and has not been reviewed by a human expert.
author: lihongmin
change_summary:
- Added a citation to H. Zhang, 'A uniform sub-three-fifths bound for exceptional abc triples', Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22151481 (published 29 August 2026), which proves N_λ(X)≪X^{34/59+ε} uniformly for 0<λ≤1: new paragraph in Section 1, one sentence in Section 7, and the abstract.
- Section 1 and Section 8 now state the exact comparison with Zhang's pointwise exponent min{2λ/3,(23λ+3)/40,34/59}: the envelope β(λ) of Theorem 1.2 is strictly smaller on 0.70≤λ<682839/724933, the exponent 34/59 is smaller on 682839/724933≤λ≤1, and for 1<λ≤1.10 Zhang's theorem does not apply. The value 682839/724933 is the exact crossing of β with 34/59, computed from the trees in the supplement.
- Section 8: replaced the sentence stating that no bound below 0.6 for N_λ(X) other than [2] had appeared by a description of Zhang's result and method.
- Reference [2] now cites the revised version 4 of rStation math_6, which carries the new title 'A two-letter collision inequality and a sub-three-fifths bound for the exceptional set in the abc conjecture'.
- Added references [8] (Zhang), [9] (Heath-Brown, arXiv:2601.07817) and [10] (Salberger, Proc. LMS 2023).
- No change to theorems, proofs, certificates or the supplement.
title: Collision inequalities and the radical budget for the exceptional set in the abc conjecture
